senses.gloss:
खच् खच् (probably for क्षच्; cf. खञ्ज् and Lat. scatere), i. 1 (and † ii. 9), Par.
 1. To spring up, Kathās. 23, 88.
 2. To appear, Lass. 73, 13.
 3. † To bind.
 खचित,
 1. Crowded, Śāk. d. 170, v. r.
 2. Inlaid, Megh. 36.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, उत्खचित, Mixed, Ragh. 13, 54.

खचर ख-चर,
 I. adj. Moving, existing, in the sky, MBh. 3, 12205.
 II. m. A bird, Rām. 4, 68, 15.
ख- + चारिन् ख- + चारिन्, adj. moving in the sky, MBh. 3, 14635.
